visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long hair wearing a purple and white striped cardigan stands in a modern kitchen setting. She holds a toddler dressed in a pink floral top and white vest. Large yellow and white text overlays the top. The woman looks flustered and gestures towards a large white tote bag on the counter. (2) Through rapid cuts, the woman is seen stuffing the tote bag with various baby supplies, including diapers, wipes, and containers, while the toddler sits on the counter. (3) The woman stands at a doorway with a much smaller purple bag, looking relaxed and smiling. She checks her phone and keys. (4) A man in a white sweater and sunglasses sits on a couch reading a newspaper, looking up as the woman and toddler prepare to leave. (5) Close-up shots of a diaper pack with 'HUGGIES' branding. A hand demonstrates the softness of the fabric and the elasticity of the waistband. (6) A demonstration of absorption is shown where a clear liquid is poured from a glass onto the diaper. (7) The woman and toddler are seated on the floor surrounded by numerous packs of diapers and wet wipes. She points to a QR code on the screen and gives a thumbs-up. (8) Final static shot of the diaper products arranged on a table with the woman and child smiling.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo pop BGM starts. A female voice speaks with high pitch and excitement, describing the stress of a first-time mother. A cartoon 'ding' sound effect triggers as she lists items. (2) Acoustic transition to a more relaxed tone; female voice becomes calmer and more informative. Short bubble-pop SFX punctuate the scene transitions. (3) A male voice speaks briefly with a low-pitch, conversational tone, followed by a slight rustling sound of a newspaper. (4) The female voice returns to a high-arousal, promotional delivery. Sound of liquid splashing onto a surface is heard clearly over the BGM. (5) Final phase features continuous speech-music overlap with recurring comedy-style SFX, ending with a bright synthesized jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comparison -> Product Demonstration -> Benefits -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Huggies Natural diapers by comparing the anxiety and over-packing of a first-time mother with the relaxed efficiency of an experienced 'third-time' mother who only needs to carry the right diaper brand. The video demonstrates the product's quality, breathiness, and absorption capacity to encourage parents to purchase from Costco's online store.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, feature demonstrations (absorption and material), and verbal recommendation of the brand name '好奇' (Huggies).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-frequency text overlays and sound effects typical of social media marketing trends to maintain high viewer engagement.
